Pedagogical Sciences of Primary Education

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

PWPO at Radboud combines scientific study of children, learning and education with preparation to teach in primary schools. Subject didactics, classroom management and supervised school placements connect educational research with everyday teaching.

UCR offers useful developmental psychology, language research and research methods. It also provides a primary-school rhetoric teaching project and study of supportive school environments. These contributions do not sustain the broad subject didactics and cumulative supervised teaching practice at the centre of PWPO. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary three-year PWPO bachelor

The 180 EC programme has 164 EC of required study and 16 EC of academic choice: 4 EC in year 2 and 12 EC in year 3. Required placements total 33 EC and progress from supervised lessons to independent teaching. Subject didactics must accompany a placement. The 10 EC thesis has academic-skills and preregistration requirements. The first-year RADAr-NL language assessment is required without credits. Some optional course replacements can affect later master internship access. Radboud’s teaching qualification does not extend to the UCR courses described here.
